<style type="text/css">
html {
   overflow-y: scroll;
}

body {
   padding: 0;
   margin: 0;
   -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
   font: 13px/1.231 arial, helvetica, clean, sans-serif;
}

body.warn-page {
   background: #ffffcc;
}

#page-container {
   margin: 0;
   padding: 0;
   min-width: 1275px;
}

.kdp-top-header {
   background:
      url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/kindlepubs/common/layouts/nav-bar-bg._V156427298_.png")
      repeat-x scroll 0 0 transparent;
   height: 29px;
}

.header-row {
   background-color: #F5F5F5;
   padding-top: 6px;
   padding-bottom: 3px;
}

.top-links {
   padding: 5px 20px;
   text-align: right;
}

.top-links a, .top-links .language-chooser, .header-item, .header-item .language-chooser {
   margin: 0 10px;
}

.kdp-delim {
   color: #CCCCCC;
}

.language-option {
   font-size: 11px;
}

.language-option a {
   margin: 5px;
}

.language-option .disable {
   color: #666666;
   margin: 0 5px;
}

body .kdp-header {
   color: #004B91;
   height: 95px;
   padding: 35px 0 0 0;
   position: relative;
   text-align: left;
}

.a-lt-ie8 body .kdp-header {
   height: 90px;
}

.tabs {
   color: #004B91;
   font-family: Arial;
   text-decoration: none;
}

.kdp-header .tabs {
   font-size: 16px;
}

.kdp-header .tabs .kdp-delim {
   padding: 0 15px;
}

.kdp-header .tabs .selected {
   font-weight: bold;
}

.account-incomplete {
   margin-top: 1em;
   position: absolute;
   right: 0;
   top: 0;
}

.account-incomplete .a-alert-content {
   font-size: 13px;
   color: #333;
}

.kdp-top-footer {
   background:
      url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/kindlepubs/common/layouts/footer-top._V192549182_.gif")
      repeat-x scroll 0 0 transparent;
   height: 23px;
   margin-top: 1em;
}

.social-footer {
   color: #666666;
   text-align: left;
}

.kdp-footer {
   color: #666666;
   text-align: left;
   font-family: Verdana, Geneva, Sans-Serif;
   font-size: 10px;
   margin: 20px 0;
   padding: 0 10px;
   position: relative;
}

.social-footer .links a, .kdp-footer .links a {
   color: #666666;
   text-decoration: underline;
}

.social-footer .links, .kdp-footer .links {
   text-align: center;
}

.kdp-footer .cr, .kdp-footer .kdp-social, .kdp-footer .links {
   padding-top: 10px;
}

.kdp-social a {
   display: inline-block;
}

.kdp-facebook {
   background:
      url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/otp/general/find-us-on-facebook-intl._V142003952_.png")
      no-repeat scroll 0 0 transparent;
   cursor: pointer;
   height: 20px;
   margin-right: 10px;
   width: 75px;
}

.en_US .kdp-facebook {
   background:
      url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/otp/general/find-us-on-facebook-a._V151334219_.png")
      no-repeat scroll 0 0 transparent;
}

.ja_JP .kdp-facebook {
   background: url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/otp/general/jp/sprite-kdp-jp._V135734257_.png")
      no-repeat scroll 0 -2820px transparent;
   height: 22px;
   margin-right: 15px;
   width: 73px;
}

.kdp-twitter {
   background:
      url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/otp/general/follow-us-on-x-intl._V1736794651_.png")
      no-repeat scroll 0 0 transparent;
   cursor: pointer;
   height: 20px;
   width: 73px;
}

.en_US .kdp-twitter {
   background:
      url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/otp/general/follow-us-on-x-a._V1736794567_.png")
      no-repeat scroll 0 0 transparent;
}

.ja_JP .kdp-twitter {
   background: url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/otp/general/jp/sprite-kdp-jp._V135734257_.png")
      no-repeat scroll 0 -2861px transparent;
   height: 22px;
   width: 78px;
}

.kdp-instagram {
   background:
      url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/otp/general/follow-us-on-instagram-intl._V1736453912_.png")
      no-repeat scroll 0 0 transparent;
   cursor: pointer;
   height: 20px;
   width: 82px;
}

.en_US .kdp-instagram {
   background:
      url("https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/otp/general/follow-us-on-instagram-a._V1736454729_.png")
      no-repeat scroll 0 0 transparent;
}

.social-footer .kdp-facebook {
   width: 20px;
   margin-right: 5px;
}

.social-footer .kdp-twitter {
   width: 30px;
}

.social-footer .kdp-instagram {
   width: 30px;
}

p.agreements-instructions {
   margin: 0 0 7px 5px;
}

.kdp-header .kdp-header-text {
   font-size: 28px;
   font-weight: normal;
   color: black;
   line-height: 1.2;
   text-align: center;
}

a:link.footer-link, a:visited.footer-link  {
   font-family: arial, sans-serif;
   color: rgb(153, 153, 153);

         <div class="a-section a-spacing-large">
            <h2 class="a-spacing-small help-title">
               Manage Your KDP Account
            </h2>
            <div class="a-section a-spacing-large help-body">
               <!--<h2>Manage Your KDP Account</h2>
https://ajuda.amazon.com/cms?object=G200634350
https://kdp.amazon.com/help?topicId=G200634350-->
Your KDP account is connected to and uses the same credentials as your Amazon customer account. Your Account is where your personal, tax, and financial information is stored. Learn how to access and update your information
<br><br>
<h5>Contents</h5>
<p></p>
<ul>
<li><a href="#change_password">Change or reset your password</a></li>
<li><a href="#change_email">Change or edit your email address</a></li>
<li><a href="#update_info">Update account information</a></li>
<li><a href="#update_banking_info">Update banking information</a></li>
<li><a href="#change_tax">Update/review tax profile</a></li>
<li><a href="#multiple_accounts">Multiple accounts</a></li>
<li><a href="#merge">Merge accounts</a></li>
<li><a href="#authorize_others">Authorize others to manage your KDP account</a></li>
<li><a href="#deceased_account">Manage a deceased author's account</a></li>
<li><a href="#closed">Close account and delete my data</a></li>
</ul>
<hr>
<a name="change_password"></a>
<h3>Change or reset your password</h3><br>
KDP uses the same credentials as your Amazon account. Whether you created your account at KDP first or used an existing Amazon account, you can update your password in <a href="https://www.amazon.com/gp/css/homepage.html">Your Account</a> on Amazon.com. To change your password: 
<p></p>
<ol>
<li>Go to the <a href="https://www.amazon.com/gp/css/account/info/view.html" target="_blank">Login & security</a> page of your Amazon customer account.
</li><li>Sign in with your current email address and password.
</li><li>Under the Password section, click <b>Edit</b>.
</li><li>Enter your new password.
</li><li>When you're done, click <b>Save changes</b>.
</li><li> Go back to the KDP homepage and <b>sign-in</b>.
</li></ol>
<br>
<hr>
<a name="change_email"></a>
<h3>Change or edit your email address</h3><br>
Whether you created your account at KDP first or used an existing Amazon customer account, you can update your email preferences in <a href="https://www.amazon.com/gp/css/homepage.html">Your Account</a> on Amazon.com. To change your email address: 
<p></p>
<ol>
<li>Go to the <a href="https://www.amazon.com/gp/css/account/info/view.html" target="_blank">Login & security</a> page of your Amazon customer account.
</li><li>Sign in with your current email address and password. 
</li><li>Under the Email section, click <b>Edit</b>. 
</li><li>Enter the new email address and the characters you see in the security challenge. 
</li><li>When you're done, click <b>Save changes</b>.
</li></ol>
<br>
<hr>
<a name="update_info"></a>
<h3>Update account information</h3><br>
To update your name, address, or phone number:
<ol>
<li>Sign in to <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com" target="_blank">KDP</a>.
</li><li>Click <b>Your Account</b> at the top of the page.
</li><li>Follow the instructions for <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/help/topic/G6HTFZJLJ7AJQ56R" target="_blank">two-step verification</a>.
</li><li>Go to <b>Account Details</b>
</li><li>Update your name, address, and phone number.
<b>Note:</b>The name provided should be the legal name of the author, and it cannot include special characters (e.g. & ! ? #). 
</li><li>Scroll to the bottom of the page and click <b>Save</b>.
</li></ol>
<br>
Amazon does not allow addresses containing a PO box. Please enter a physical address.
<br><br>
<b>Note:</b> After editing your account, we may ask you to verify your identity. For details, <a href="/help?topicId=GH7TYHP6FR9QAUM9">visit this Help article</a>. If you previously verified your identity, you will need to re-verify once you save changes.
<br><br>
<b>Important:</b> Your tax info should reflect your legal name reported on tax forms and your bank info should match what's on your bank account.
<br><br>
Changing your phone number doesn’t update the number for two-step. Learn how to change your number for <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/help/topic/G6HTFZJLJ7AJQ56R">two-step verification.</a>
<br><br>
<b>Note</b>: For security reasons, KDP customer service does not share account creation dates.
<br><br>
<hr>
<a name="update_banking_info"></a>
<h3>Update banking information</h3><br>
Learn more about <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/help/topic/GUFL3496V6U2ESA7">updating your banking details.</a>.
<br><br>
<hr>
<h3>Update/Review tax profile</h3>

<br>
Country-specific tax regulations require Amazon to request information about your tax identity under country-specific law to establish your tax identity with us. This is because Amazon issues payments that can be regarded as income. We must receive and validate your tax identity before you can update existing books or publish new books in the Kindle store.<br><br>

To complete the tax profile:
<br>
<ol>
<li>Go to <a href="https://account.kdp.amazon.com/account">Your Account</a>.
</li><li>Under <b>Your Account</b>, click <b>Tax Information</b>.
</li><li>Click <b>Complete Tax Profile</b>. If you're updating your tax information, click <b>Update/Review Tax Profile</b>.
</li></ol>
Answer all the questions and enter all the requested information in the form. You may update or review your tax profile anytime your information or circumstances change. You can check the status of your tax information anytime under the Tax Information section of your KDP Account. After you complete your tax profile, you’ll see a status of “Complete".
<br><br>
<hr>
<a name="multiple_accounts"></a>
<h3>Multiple accounts</h3><br>
To manage your KDP books efficiently, we recommend you maintain all your KDP books under a single account. Both Amazon and KDP have a policy which prevents creating a second account under a different email address, or under an email address that's associated with an already existing account.
<br><br>
For more information, refer to our <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/terms-and-conditions" target="_blank">Terms and Conditions</a>.  
<br><br>
If you have Kindle books published through different KDP accounts, we can merge them all in to one and close the secondary account.
<br><br>
<hr>
<a name="merge"></a>
<h3>Merge accounts</h3><br>
To have your accounts merged, you'll need to review and provide the following:
<ul>
<li>Ensure to write from the email address associated with KDP account you want to merge into another account.<br>
</li><li>Have a least one book in "Live" status in the KDP account you want to merge into another account.</li><li>Provide a title of one book and its corresponding ASIN or ISBN from the KDP account you want to merge into another account.</li><li>Remove any Ads promoting your KDP books and re-create new Ads from your new account, if applicable.<br>
</li><li>Ensure your bank details information is updated to pay any outstanding royalties. Learn more about <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/help/topic/GUFL3496V6U2ESA7">updating bank details</a>.</li>
<li>Verify that both accounts have complete information (tax, bank details) before accounts can be merged.</li></ul>
<div><b>Note</b>: We cannot move specific books from one account to another.<br></div>
<br>
Merging your KDP accounts will move your published books from your old KDP account to your new one. The below information will not be transferred:
<ul>
<li>Old account information
</li><li>Tax profile details
</li><li>Sales reports
</li><li>Payment information to the new account</li><li>Active Ads running for your book published in old account
</li><li>A+ Content. You can replicate your projects on the new account.</li></ul>

Reports will no longer be accessible with the old account. We recommend downloading your reports before merging accounts. 
<br><br>
After you gather the information we need and verify your account details, <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/contact-us" target="_blank">contact us</a>. We'll move the old account information to the new account and then confirm that this is done. 
<br><br>
<hr>
<a name="authorize_others"></a>
<h3>Authorize others to manage your KDP account</h3><br>
We do not recommend multiple users using the same login credentials to access an account. 
<br><br>
Here are some potential issues: 
<br>
<ul>
<li>It may be a security risk. For example, if someone with access to the account leaves your company or organization, that person might still be able to log in to the account. 
</li><li>It would require that all users have access to both the primary and backup devices when they log in.
</li><li>If the two-step verification code is being sent to a mobile phone, and the owner of that phone isn’t available, the user trying to log in won’t receive the code.
</li></ul>
<hr>
<a name="deceased_account"></a>
<h3>Manage a deceased author's account</h3><br>
Our team can help you during this difficult time. To request access to a KDP author's account after they have passed away or become incapacitated, please <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/contact-us">contact us</a>. To access the contact us form, either sign-in or <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/help/topic/G200620010">create a free KDP account</a>. We take security very seriously, so before we can help you access the account, you will need to provide the following documentation:
<br><br>
<ul>
<li>Death certificate</li>
<li>One of the following court-issued letters indicating that you own the rights to the account:
<ul>
<li>Estate Owner</li>
<li>Next Executor</li>
<li>Next of kin</li>
<li>Will</li>
</ul>
</li></ul>
Once you have access to the account, our team can help you to either close, merge, or take ownership of the account.
<br><br>
<hr>
<a name="closed"></a>
<h3>Close account and delete my data</h3><br>
Once your KDP account is closed, it is no longer accessible to you, it cannot be restored, we will process your data deletion request, and your agreement to the KDP Terms and Conditions will be terminated. To learn more, visit our <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/help/topic/G7UNC4ZSTL3UYZCC" target="_self">account closure FAQs</a>.
<br><br>
Before closing your account:
<ul>
<li> We recommend you review your account to confirm <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/help/topic/G200634350#update_info">your name, mailing address, bank account number, and bank routing number</a> are accurate. This ensures that you receive any outstanding royalties, if eligible.
</li><li> You may wish to download your <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/help/topic/GVTTXHKHVPAPBEDQ#download_reports">KDP reports</a> and <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/en_US/help/topic/G201990460#access_howto">tax forms</a>, as you will permanently lose access to this information if you close your KDP account. 
</li></ul>
To submit a request to close your KDP account and delete your data:
<ol>
<li>Go to our <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/contact-us">contact us</a>.</li>
<li>Tell the <b>KDP Assistant</b> you would like to close your account (e.g. say 'Close my account').</li>
<li>It might provide you with information on closing your account. If needed, ask to be transferred (e.g. say 'Transfer me').</li>
<li>Choose to <b>Connect with KDP Support</b>, and then select <b>Send email</b>. This will direct you to the form for closing your account.</li>
<li>A confirmation notification will be sent to the email address associated with your KDP account. You’ll have 10 days to confirm your request.</li>
</ol>
<br>
Once your request is confirmed, we will unpublish your books and process any outstanding royalties due to you, if eligible, in the next payment cycle. Please note, per our <a href="https://kdp.amazon.com/help/topic/G200627430">KDP Terms and Conditions</a>, we may continue to sell any inventory we have of your print books, and we may fulfill any customer orders for your print books pending as of the date we confirm your account closure and data deletion request. We may continue to maintain digital copies of your digital books in order to provide continuing access to or re-downloads of your digital books, as well as digital copies of your books to support customers who have purchased your book prior to your account closure and data deletion request.

   2 KDP Select Benefits. <br>
     <br>
   2.1 <strong> </strong>Promotional Pricing Programs. During each 90-day KDP Select enrollment term, you may run your Digital Book in either a Kindle Countdown Deals or a free promotion. <br>
